cityQuote: When I realized that I would see this light every morning, I could not believe my happiness.
cityQuoteAttribution: Henri Matisse, on settling in Nice
heroTitle: Nice hero — Tobi 87 (CC BY-SA 3.0, Wikimedia Commons)
wordsPreamble:
- English is widely spoken in Nice, which has welcomed foreign visitors for 250 years. Starting with “bonjour” still matters.
- Nice belonged to the Kingdom of Sardinia until 1860, and Italian is common: menus, family names, and the old language, Nissart, all show it.
- Street signs in the old town are in French and Nissart.
- Greet the shopkeeper when you enter and say goodbye when you leave, even if you buy nothing.
